verdict.rationale: Provisioning locations and registering card readers through an API is a fair question for a POS product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents neither a location-creation API nor a reader-registration API. The only API mentions are POS UI extensions that can call the GraphQL Admin API, which is a developer building block rather than the provisioning capability. Multi-location back-office claims cover management, not programmatic provisioning.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new location end-to-end via API — creating the location and registering its readers
